rules.name: Every sequence has START MID END anchors
rules.enforcement: Each sequence stores distinct START, MID, and END frame plans even when still images are not generated.

rules.name: Frames store complete physical state
rules.enforcement: Store visible characters and assets, positions, action, camera, lens, composition, environment, lighting, continuity, references, and prompt.

rules.name: START reconciles with approved continuity
rules.enforcement: START state matches the prior approved END unless a direct, match, time-jump, location, or new-angle transition is explicitly recorded.

rules.name: MID changes state without breaking locks
rules.enforcement: Movement, information, threat, object transfer, damage, position, and emotion may change, but locked assets may not.

rules.name: END is an exact continuity handoff
rules.enforcement: END records exact outgoing positions, direction, wardrobe, injuries, props, entities, location, camera, lighting, weather, facts, motion, and emotion.

rules.name: Frame prompts separate control layers
rules.enforcement: Separate locked references, physical state, composition, camera/lens, light/colour, frozen action, and negative continuity constraints.
